description: This file defines the CustomFieldDao class responsible for managing custom fields within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching custom fields, as well as handling their association with display fields and ORM transactions.

classes.name: CustomFieldDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling CRUD operations and queries related to custom fields within the system.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Saves a custom field to the database, assigning a new field number if necessary, and linking it with display fields.

methods.name: addCustomFieldToDisplayField
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a display field, creating display field entries if they do not already exist.

methods.name: getCustomFieldById
methods.description: Retrieves a custom field by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingCustomFieldIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing custom field IDs matching the provided list.

methods.name: deleteCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes specified custom fields and their associated display fields within a transaction.

methods.name: deleteDisplayFieldsOfCustomFields
methods.description: Removes display fields associated with specified custom fields.

methods.name: searchCustomField
methods.description: Searches for custom fields based on provided filter parameters and returns matching entries.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for custom field search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of custom fields matching specific search criteria.

methods.name: isCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if a custom field is currently in use by any employees.

methods.name: updateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Updates employee records, nullifying custom field values where a specific drop-down value is used.
